historical_cv_qlike.evaluation_protocol: 5-Fold Purged Walk-Forward Cross-Validation with 168h purge boundary between folds
historical_cv_qlike.purpose: Historical training benchmark and cross-validation baseline for feature/model selection.

corrected_2026_holdout_qlike.evaluation_protocol: Strict Zero-Leakage Holdout Simulation (No training labels past 2025-12-24T23:00:00Z)
corrected_2026_holdout_qlike.purpose: Repaired retrospective holdout validation score proving post-repair generalization.

reconciliation_summary: Both metrics represent true and distinct evaluations of HAR-RS-DOW-v1.0 across different temporal partitions and evaluation methodologies. 0.19300 represents historical 5-fold CV loss (2022-2025), whereas 0.156993 represents the repaired 2026 holdout partition loss. Neither value was modified or tuned.
